title: rosa canina f. glaucina
intro: Rosa canina f. glaucina, commonly known as the dog rose or wild rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina species, native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. glaucina include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, such as salicylic acid and rosavin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
